message.content: Starting triage on the reported pole failure — shrinking to a minimal case.
Shrink isolated a failing case — now confirming it replays deterministically.
Replay confirmed — inspecting the states around the violation.
Ledger: open - sensor noise destabilizing controller, large dt, initial offset; ruled out - pushes (none), force saturation (force 10 << limit 67). Inspecting earlier trajectory.
Failure builds rapidly near the end — checking earlier to trace the divergence.
Early growth suggests noise-driven drift — checking the start before testing a counterfactual.
My hypothesis: seeded sensor noise destabilizes the feedback controller. Testing by removing noise while keeping everything else identical.
